# scylladbcloud_account (Data Source)

The ScyllaDB Cloud account the provider's token belongs to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "scylladbcloud_account" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (Number) Account ID.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `name` (String) Account name.
- `role` (String) The caller's role in the account, e.g. ADMIN.
- `status` (String) Account status, e.g. ACTIVE.
- `user_account_status` (String) The caller's membership status in the account.
- `user_id` (Number) The caller's user ID.
